runtime.mutation_scope: this repository worktree only; every audited subject was read-only and no sibling checkout was written, branched or pushed

what_this_receipt_is: Four canary lanes for the read-only Shadow closure audit. Each lane records the exact subject, the command that ran, its exit code and the digests of what it produced. A lane proves that subject at that revision and nothing else.

lanes.subject: ed3c/ai-content-notes
lanes.question: README and gate status versus the current validator report and the open forge items

result.headline: the README states a ten-gate host-validated subset while the committed validator report for the same batch records twelve; twelve external gates have never been run for a batch whose check runs are green at this head

lanes.read_only_evidence: the checkout was left at its own HEAD with an empty porcelain status; no file in it was written by this run

lanes.subject: ed3c/ai-product-notes
lanes.question: technical history count versus the customer, paid and owner gates

checkout.note: no local checkout of this repository existed; the shallow clone was made in a scratch directory outside every tracked repository, read only, never pushed, and is not retained. Re-verification requires re-cloning at the recorded revision.

argv: <scratch clone of ed3c/ai-product-notes at the recorded revision>

result.headline: nineteen closed technical items move no rung above TECH_VERIFIED; the user, paid and owner lanes are each owned by an open gate and the market experiment declares its own state unexercised

lanes.subject: the PDF-derived product-internals claim in ed3c/ai-product-notes#49

result.headline: the internal stack attributed to the named products stays a hypothesis: no observation of any of them exists in the subject, and the source document is an attachment with no digest anywhere in the repository, so the exact-subject chain breaks at the first link

lanes.not_claimed: this lane says nothing about whether the source document's description of those products is correct; it says the subject holds no evidence that could settle it

lanes.subject: a green CI run presented as live, user and commercial closure

artifacts.note: the CANARY-2 audit with exactly one change: the three unentered lanes marked PASS and anchored to the CI run that really is green
the same audit with one defect instead: the paid rung marked PASS on the live model's advocacy paragraph

refusals: EVIDENCE_LANE_PROMOTION PRB-001.LIVE_WORKFLOW_VERIFIED is closed by a CI_RUN anchor; that level admits ['LIVE_WORKFLOW_RUN']
EVIDENCE_LANE_PROMOTION PRB-001.USER_VALIDATED is closed by a CI_RUN anchor; that level admits ['USER_REPORT']
EVIDENCE_LANE_PROMOTION PRB-001.PAID_VALIDATED is closed by a CI_RUN anchor; that level admits ['HUMAN_ADMISSION', 'PAID_CONVERSION']
MODEL_JUDGE_OVERRIDE PRB-001.PAID_VALIDATED is PASS on a model judgement; a judge may describe evidence and may not be the evidence
LEVEL_LADDER_SKIP PRB-001 declares 'PAID_VALIDATED'; the level states earn 'TECH_VERIFIED'

live_calls.purpose: ask a live model for the closure level the same facts earn
live_calls.reading: the model agreed with the deterministic verdict, which is a pleasant result and not the control: an agreeing judge never tests whether the veto holds

live_calls.purpose: produce genuine fluent advocacy for the promoted level, so the veto is tested against prose rather than against a straw sentence
live_calls.verdict: a paragraph concluding that the evidence is complete and unanimous and that anything beyond closing at the paid level is ceremony
live_calls.reading: the paragraph is filed as the only anchor under the paid rung in canary-model-judgment-refused.rejected.json, and the checker refuses it by name; the refusal did not read the paragraph

non_claims: an audit of two repositories at two revisions is not evidence about any other repository, revision or product
the two live calls are one host, one model and two prompts; they measure that these refusals hold against this prose, not that no prose ever moves a reviewer
no lane here establishes that either audited product works, is wanted, or is safe to operate
selecting which problems were material was a judgement by the auditing worker and no deterministic control covers it
